events.name: Blueprint
events.description: Blueprint is the kind of improv that keeps audiences AND players on their toes. Each week, a different cast member designs a bold new improv format that their fellow performers will learn about at the same time as the crowd. Expect the unexpected as we build something completely original, live, right before your eyes. Past forms have included: Improvised Severance - Guided by two internal "staff members," three performers are physically out of the room, while three others perform as their innies, and every 5 minutes, the two swapped. Can they make sense of their outies? and versa? Understudies - In a longform narrative, each player on stage knows that they will eventually understudy another player in the show. The lights change and they have to embody a different player, and each time the lights change, they can select another player to embody. Overachiever - Three 2-person monoscenes happen on stage, utilizing the same physical space, but taking place in categorically different spaces. They must navigate space atop of and around one another while keeping connection to their partner. Improvised Heist - Ocean's Eleven, eat your heart out! Our players hit the major plot points of a heist and improvise their way through - initial idea, building the team, planning the heist, executing, and the aftermath Blueprint is joined each week by a lab cast opening for the show with their own unique, original form. Directed by James Dugan Cast:James DuganAvery FordMolly JonesAllen LucasJanelle SoulliereRyan Bowman _____________________ Additional option to include our spooky October cocktail, "😈Rosemary’s Bay Breeze😈", with your ticket. It features a pour of Crown Apple mixed with crisp apple cider and cranberry juice, striking a balance of sweet, tart, and orchard fruit notes. Served over ice and garnished with a sprig of rosemary. Best part? Gratuity is included. Got a Drink Add-on? Follow these steps: Show your ticket to the host and mention the drink add-on.Grab your token and place it on your table.Enjoy your drink as a server will bring it by shortly. Note: Valid ID is required for all alcohol service. No ID, no drink, no refunds.

One of our world-famous referees will guide you through the whole show and may even ask for your help on stage. Every show ends in our incredible 6 THINGS game that is known throughout the world as 'the hardest game in all of improv'.  It's fast. It's hilarious. It's appropriate for all ages. It's ComedySportz.

events.name: Improvised Romantasy
events.description: Ancient blood curses, wicked bargains, hilarious chaos, and sexual tension capable of raising both the dead and the stakes. No script. No safety net. You hand our comedy ensemble your spiciest tropes and darkest fantasy prompts, and we bring an unscripted, wildly funny gothic romance to life right before your eyes. Will they break the curse or succumb to the bite? You hold the quill this Halloween.

events.name: This Year in Music: 2007
events.description: This Year in Music is back and we celebrating all the legendary and glamorous hits of 2007! We’re welcoming performers from all over the city to honor one iconic year through singing, dancing, storytelling, and epic sketch comedy. So dust off your shutter shades, get ready to crank that 2007 nostalgia - we guarantee it’ll be a sweet escape! Featuring: Amber Linde Arne Parrott Brad Johnson Brixton McMillan Carter Wright Chris Jowett Claudia Baffo Courtney Crary Dan Shea Elise Leonhart James Dugan Jamie Burns Jordan Stafford Kelly Dugan Maria Sharps Matty Vergun Molly Jones Molly Walburn Niah Whitley Rob Grabowski The Qs Sarah Dell Amico Tina Arfaee Yassi Baharloo bringing you the hits of Rihanna, Amy Winehouse, Paramore, T-Pain, Fall Out Boy, Fergie, MGMT, Radiohead, and MORE!! _____________________ Additional option to include our spooky October cocktail, "😈Rosemary’s Bay Breeze😈", with your ticket. It features a pour of Crown Apple mixed with crisp apple cider and cranberry juice, striking a balance of sweet, tart, and orchard fruit notes. Served over ice and garnished with a sprig of rosemary. Best part? Gratuity is included. Got a Drink Add-on? Follow these steps: Show your ticket to the host and mention the drink add-on.Grab your token and place it on your table.Enjoy your drink as a server will bring it by shortly. Note: Valid ID is required for all alcohol service. No ID, no drink, no refunds.
